title: Start here if you have not trained in a year: 3 moves
caption: Workout for beginners who have not trained in a year: three easy moves, two rounds, about six minutes. Wall Push-Up, Supported Sit-to-Stand and Glute Bridge. Save this for day one.

overlays.text: Start here if you have not trained in a year.

scenes.footer: Push. The easiest push there is.

overlays.text: Wall Push-Up. 10 reps. Hands on the wall, lower your chest in, press away.

scenes.footer: Squat. Your hands help, on purpose.

overlays.text: Supported Sit-to-Stand. 8 reps. Hands on the chair seat, stand up, sit down slowly.

scenes.footer: Hinge. The floor does half the work.

overlays.text: Glute Bridge. 10 reps. Lie on your back, feet flat, push your hips up.

scenes.footer: No pull or core yet. They come in week two.

overlays.text: Two rounds of the three. About six minutes. That is day one.
